messages:
monica.procure: Heads-up — Vendor X sent their pilot pricing for the bulk ingestion POC. A few weird line items and I'm not sure how the commit credit stacking works with our renewal. Can @samir.finance or @jess.billing confirm?

samir.finance: thanks, forwarding the spreadsheet now. quick read: pricing looks per-GB for ingest + per-10k events for processing. They also included a "startup pilot" credit that expires at renewal.

eli.sales: do we have negotiation leverage to make pilot credits apply toward the first-year commit? that was our usual ask for platform pilots.

jess.billing: I skimmed — their terms say credits are "non-transferable" and "not applicable to reserved commit discounts". need to confirm if that means they won't count against committed spend.

monica.procure: Ugh. Their example invoice looks like this:
```
2026-02-01 Vendor X Invoice #4321
- Bulk ingest (GB): 12000 @ $0.015/GB = $180.00
- Event processing (10k): 15 @ $5.00 = $75.00
- Pilot credit: -$250.00 (applied)
Net due: $5.00
```
They applied the pilot credit on the invoice but their contract language suggests it wouldn't count toward committed spend.

samir.finance: If pilot credit is not eligible for commit, it reduces cash out now but doesn't reduce our committed liability. That's common but we should push to have credits offset first-year commit if we sign. Otherwise the math on unit economics is misleading.

eli.sales: propose three asks for negotiation: 1) allow pilot credits to roll into year-1 commit; 2) cap ingest egress fees for first 6 months; 3) include SLA credits for >99.9% uptime. anyone object?

jess.billing: agree on (1) and (3). (2) fine but need vendor to specify exact egress thresholds. Also need accounting to confirm recognition treatment if credits move to commit. @samir.finance?

samir.finance: Accounting note: if credits are applied to committed spend, revenue recognition shifts for them — they'd likely treat it as a discount on services. That's ok as long as legal signs it. From our side we'll need a negotiated clause: "Pilot credits, if applied, shall be treated as prepayments toward the first 12 months of committed services and reduce committed fees dollar-for-dollar."

monica.procure: I'll draft that clause. Also vendor asked whether we need SOC2 or can rely on ISO27001. For a pilot with ingest of PII-lite telemetry, security team wants SOC2.

eli.sales: we'll flag SOC2 required for any ingest beyond 10k devices or if data contains IPs. Keep pilot scope narrower if vendor can't deliver SOC2 before start.

vendorbot: Vendor X uploaded revised terms: https://vendorx.example.com/terms/2026-02-12 (doc v1.1)

monica.procure: thanks. I'm going to propose: accept the pilot invoice for immediate payment, conditionally apply credits to year-1 commit only upon signed amendment, and require SOC2 attestation before expanding ingest scope. Thoughts? :thinking:

jess.billing: sounds good. Add payment milestone: we pay pilot invoice within 15 days, vendor must provide signed amendment within 45 days or credits revert to non-applicable.

samir.finance: add an "audit right" clause so we can verify credit usage against invoices. Also limit pre-applied credits to actual pilot usage (no over-application).

eli.sales: I'll run the ask past our rep and push for 1) amendment language, 2) SLA credits, 3) SOC2 timeline. If vendor resists, we can offer a smaller pilot or shorter credit expiry.

monica.procure: perfect. I'll update the PO request and attach the invoice and v1.1 terms. tagging finance for final sign-off before PO: @samir.finance @jess.billing

samir.finance: will review tonight. if ok, we greenlight payment.

jess.billing: will review for accounting treatment and update chartfield for the pilot spend.

monica.procure: thanks all. I'll post the amended clause draft here when ready.
